name: axora-one
description: AXORA ONE — enterprise construction/engineering platform (Wave 1 foundation)

scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @axora/api build && pnpm --filter @axora/web build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @axora/types build && pnpm --filter @axora/security build && pnpm --filter @axora/design-system build && pnpm --filter @axora/database build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @axora/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @axora/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @axora/security test && pnpm --filter @axora/api test
